Report Issue

Send the problem to the right teams

Describe the issue once. The system checks the category and description and routes the same report to every relevant department with the same area of responsibility.

You can attach multiple JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, or HEIC images. Maximum 5 images, 5 MB each.
Routing: Select a category to see which departments will receive this report.
Demo behavior: reports are saved in this browser so they can be tracked. To send them to real university department email/inbox systems, connect the submit function to your backend/API.
